post_run_audit.reason: Strengthened terminal-result, native order tag/type/quantity, margin timestamp/count and request-log attribution after initial result reconciliation. Original native artifacts were audited; no engine rerun or parameter change.

reused_helpers.scope: Native sandbox, compiler-command execution, hashing and JSON persistence; no prior tests or native scenarios rerun unchanged.

limitations: Known 2020 crash development interval selected for stress; no untouched holdout, alpha estimate, automatic winner selection or profitability claim.
One SPY instrument; no historical +200% mover/catalyst census, full point-in-time eligible universe, delisting or strategy-factor acceptance.

Every discretionary intent used native next-session MarketOnOpen. Hourly-data fills are recorded at 10:00 New York with bar-open proxies; no exact 09:30 auction/tick/queue/depth or latency acceptance.
Native default margin calls use same-event market fills and trade-bar fallback warnings. Their timing is an engine stress behavior, not a calibrated broker risk/liquidation model.
2% sizing buffer and 2x SecurityMarginModel are declared simulation assumptions; actual gross can rise above 2x after losses. No present Alpaca account or leverage eligibility was queried.
Drawdown/gross metrics use 725 hourly callback observations after engine processing. Intrabar risk and pre-liquidation risk can be worse; margin callback values are retained separately.
Raw-data dividends are included. Source feed, corporate-action completeness, original availability and contemporary entitlement are not authenticated by bundled file hashes.
No financing/borrow interest configured. The engine reads an interest-rate reference file for its own calculations; this does not establish financing-inclusive cash PnL.
All fills assume full quantity. Fixed $1/order and 20 basis points are illustrative stresses, not estimated broker fees or attainable liquidity.
Stderr contains three margin-liquidation log entries in each 2x case and the expected insufficient-buying-power rejection in over_limit; exit zero is not described as empty stderr.
Cash reconciliation is exact over exported values with a one-cent comparison tolerance; omitted internal precision is not recovered.
Hashes establish byte identity, not independent attestation. Native integration is this local fixture around upstream APIs, not an unchanged upstream sample.
